text: /// Ask the user about each undecided offer, then record the answers.
/// hook dispatch and anything an agent triggers use a quiet or capturing
/// output, so they return here immediately without touching stdin. In those
/// contexts the candidates surface as a `SessionStart` hint instead (see
/// Only explicit answers are recorded — the default ("ask me later") leaves
/// the dependency undecided, so reflexively hitting Enter never permanently
/// declines anything, and Escape leaves the remaining offers undecided too.
Some(_) => {}  // ask me later — record nothing
None => break, // Esc — leave the rest undecided

rationale:
In `prompt_for_consent`, the select's default is index 0 ("Ask me later"); `Some(_)` other than 1/2 adds the name to neither list, and `None` (Escape, from `interact_opt`) breaks out of the loop. `apply_consent` is then called with only explicit answers, and returns immediately without saving when both lists are empty. So a deferred or cancelled question leaves `[plugins]` untouched for that dependency. (A dialoguer I/O error returns early via `?` before `apply_consent`, also recording nothing.)

Untested: these branches need a TTY; judged from code. `tests/enablement.rs` `consent_prompt_never_fires_non_interactively` only shows that the non-interactive path records nothing.
requirement: Symposium MUST record nothing for a consent prompt answered with the default ("Ask me later") or cancelled.
